notes: Three added units here, all supplied English pronouns or subject nouns with no answering morpheme (rules 17, 44); rule 44 names wayyappel -> 'he let it fall' as this very case.
The whereby unit is an indivisible rule 22 fusion of relative, preposition and resumptive suffix.
kol takes the written any under rule 15, since a kol standing on the noun is itself what that determiner renders.
